FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Which service do I need?

Tell us the problem you're trying to solve. We'll recommend the right service, or combination of services, in plain language.

Do you work with startups as well as established businesses?

Yes. We help startups launch focused first versions and help established businesses modernise and connect their systems.

Can you take over an existing project?

Yes. We review the code, infrastructure and documentation first, then agree a plan to stabilise and continue the work.

Do you work with clients outside Noida?

Yes. We are based in Greater Noida West and work with clients across India, mostly through regular video calls.

Not sure which service you need?

Tell us about the problem you are trying to solve. We'll recommend the right approach, without jargon or pressure.
